The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection has officially released the IBPS Clerk Mains Result 2026 for the Common Recruitment Process for Clerical Cadre (CRP CSA-XV) on 2nd March 2026 on the official website at ibps.in. This recruitment drive is being conducted to fill 15701 Clerk vacancies across participating public sector banks. The IBPS Clerk Phase 2 Result has been announced after the mains examination. Candidates who appeared for the examination can now check their qualifying status, marks, and further selection details on the official website.

The IBPS Clerk recruitment process is conducted in three stages i.e., the Preliminary Examination, the Main Examination, and the Language Proficiency Test (LPT). With the declaration of the mains result, the recruitment process has entered its final phase, as the mains exam serves as the final merit-deciding stage. In this article, candidates can find the direct link to check the IBPS Clerk Result 2025–26, along with scorecard details, cut off updates, and information on final selection and allotment.

IBPS Clerk Mains Result 2026 Out @ibps.in

The IBPS Clerk Result 2026 has been officially announced by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) for the Mains stage on 2nd March 2026. Candidates can now check their Mains result online on the official IBPS website, using their login credentials. Candidates can also access their IBPS Clerk Mains scorecard and state-wise cut off marks by logging in using their credentials. The final merit list for IBPS Clerk recruitment is prepared based on the marks obtained in the mains examination only, as the prelims exam is qualifying in nature. Candidates who meet the cut off criteria in the mains exam are considered for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT) and provisional allotment to participating banks.

The IBPS Clerk Recruitment is currently being conducted under the CRP CSA-XV process. The notification for this recruitment cycle was released by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection to fill 15,701 vacancies of Clerks in the public sector bank groupings. IBPS Clerk Mains Result 2025-26 Download Link

Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has declared the result for the IBPS Clerk Mains Exam 2025–26. The candidates who appeared in the mains examination can download and check their result from the official website now. The result is available online on the official site of IBPS at ibps.in. To check the result, candidates need to log in with their registration number/ roll no. with date of birth or password. The IBPS Clerk Result 2025–26 can be downloaded using the direct link provided below.

IBPS Clerk Mains Result 2025-26 Out – Click Here To Download

How to Download IBPS Clerk Phase 2 Result 2025-26?

The Mains result for IBPS Clerk Mains 2026 can be downloaded by logging in to the official website. Candidates can follow the step-by-step process outlined below to check and download the IBPS Clerk Mains Result 2026.

  1. Visit the official website of the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection at ibps.in.
  2. On the homepage, click on the CRP Clerical / CSA-XV recruitment link.
  3. Open the link titled “IBPS Clerk Mains Result 2026.”
  4. Enter your registration number or roll number along with your date of birth or password.
  5. Submit the details to view the IBPS Clerk Mains Result 2025 on the screen.
  6. Download the result and keep a printout for future reference.

Details Mentioned on IBPS Clerk Mains Result

Candidates are advised to carefully read all instructions mentioned on the result page. The IBPS Clerk Result page contains important information related to the candidate’s performance and selection status, including:

  • Candidate’s registration or roll number
  • Qualifying status for provisional allotment
  • Instructions related to scorecard availability
  • Official notes issued by IBPS regarding the next stage

What After IBPS Clerk Phase 2 Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify the IBPS Clerk Mains Examination 2026 proceed to the final stages of the recruitment process. The mains examination is the final merit-deciding stage, and shortlisted candidates are considered for further selection formalities as prescribed by IBPS.

  • Selection is done on the basis of the marks scored in the mains examination, along with the state-wise merit list.
  • Candidates shortlisted at this stage are required to appear for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT).
  • The LPT is a qualifying test and checks whether the candidate can read, write, and speak the local language of the state they are allotted.
  • Candidates who qualify the LPT are then considered for provisional allotment to participating public sector banks.
  • The final appointment is completed after document verification and other joining formalities prescribed by the allotted bank.

IBPS Clerk Mains Result 2025-26 FAQs

Q1: Where can candidates check the IBPS Clerk Mains Result 2025-26?

Ans: Candidates can check the IBPS Clerk Mains Result 2025–26 on the official IBPS website, ibps.in, by logging in with their registration number or roll number and date of birth or password.

Q2: Has the IBPS Clerk Mains scorecard been released?

Ans: Yes, the IBPS Clerk Mains scorecard 2026 has been released along with the mains result. The scorecard displays section-wise marks, overall marks, and the final score used for merit preparation.

Q3: What is the IBPS Clerk Mains cut off 2026?

Ans: The IBPS Clerk Mains cut off 2026 is the minimum score required in the mains examination for consideration in the final merit list and provisional allotment. The cut off has been released category-wise by IBPS along with the result.

Q4: Which marks are considered for the IBPS Clerk final merit list?

Ans: Only the marks obtained in the mains examination are considered for preparing the IBPS Clerk final merit list, as the preliminary examination is qualifying in nature.

Q5: What is the next step after IBPS Clerk Mains Result 2025-26?

Ans: After the mains result, shortlisted candidates must appear for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT). Candidates who qualify the LPT are then considered for provisional allotment and document verification.
